Initialize the accumulated radiance $E = 0$ and the current transmittance $T = 1$.
Compute the transmittance factor for the current segment: $F = \exp(-\tau_i \Delta s_i)$.
Update the accumulated radiance: $E = E + T \cdot c_i \cdot (1 - F)$.
Update the current transmittance: $T = T \cdot F$.
After the loop, add the contribution from the background: $E = E + T \cdot B$.
